audit_question: Is there a DUAL_SYSTEM_OF_RECORD between Turso and Neon?
audit_answer: NO — no DUAL_SYSTEM_OF_RECORD detected. Each domain has exactly one CANONICAL_OWNER. Turso and Neon serve distinct, non-overlapping roles.

turso.deployment_model: edge-replicated SQLite for low-latency transactional reads/writes
canonical_owner_for: transactional data (users, sessions, accounts, obligations, settlement events, mint records, reserve policy state)
operational domain entities (any entity with transactional semantics)
turso.schema_file: prisma/schema.prisma (69 lines, present, unchanged from P74 baseline)
turso.migrations_note: prisma/migrations/ absent; db:push used (intentional per worklog). NOT_APPLICABLE finding LD-17.

neon.deployment_model: serverless Postgres for analytics replica + AI Gateway metadata + S3 evidence archive index
canonical_owner_for: analytics replica (read-optimized copy of transactional data for dashboards, KPI recalculation, sampling)
S3 evidence archive index (evidence-room index, evidence-fabric pointers)
AI Gateway metadata (model invocations, token usage, prompt-response audit log)
long-term evidence retention store (off-edge cold storage)
neon.schema_file: prisma/schema.prisma (same schema; Neon uses the same Prisma schema with DATABASE_BACKEND=neon fallback in src/lib/db.ts — see commit 9a97cae)

s3_archive.canonical_owner: Neon-managed (S3 index referenced via Neon tables)

ai_gateway.canonical_owner: Neon-managed (AI Gateway metadata persisted to Neon)

evidence: src/lib/db.ts uses DATABASE_BACKEND env var to select Turso (default) or Neon (manual fallback) — see commit 9a97cae. This is a controlled fallback, NOT a dual-write system of record.
No code path writes the SAME entity to BOTH Turso and Neon simultaneously. Turso is primary-write; Neon is replica-read + analytics.
No invariant requires dual-consistency between Turso and Neon. Each provider owns distinct domain slices (per CANONICAL_OWNER above).
Reconciliation (if any) is one-directional: Turso → Neon (analytics replica push), NOT bidirectional dual-write.
P74 invariant I04 (no dual-system-of-record) was PASS in P74 and remains PASS in P75/P76 — unchanged.

canonical_owner_assignment.summary: Every domain has exactly ONE canonical owner. No domain is dual-owned. Therefore: NO_DUAL_SYSTEM_OF_RECORD.

runtime_verifiability.reason: Cannot test connectivity — all 4 providers (Turso, Neon, S3, AI Gateway) are BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_SECRET. .env is a 52-line template; 0 actual secrets provisioned. P0 CRITICAL: secrets must be operator-provisioned before any runtime verification.
runtime_verifiability.schema_only_conclusion: Based on schema (prisma/schema.prisma) + code (src/lib/db.ts DATABASE_BACKEND branch) inspection: the architecture is single-system-of-record per domain. DUAL_SYSTEM_OF_RECORD would only arise if a code path wrote the same entity to both providers — none does.
